verdict.rationale: Graphite documents a direct Cursor link: a Cloud Agents conversation started in Cursor can continue in Graphite. Its own Agent and one-click suggested fixes act on review feedback inside the PR page. However, nothing shows review findings being exported or handed off to an external coding agent; the documented Cursor flow runs from Cursor into Graphite. missing for 10: copyable fix prompts for review findings, handoff of AI-review findings to Cursor/Claude Code/Codex, any Claude Code or Codex integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, review findings hand off cleanly to my coding agent — copyable fix prompts or direct integration with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex

citations.quote: You can start a conversation with Cloud Agents in Cursor, then continue the same agent thread in Graphite.
Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page.
Make direct code changes right from your PR page. Click Agent on the right side of the PR to get started.
